decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete message-42 Event establishing the exact assessment-date copy policy, so no additional or corrected MODIFY is required.
The assessment-date field format does not change the required fonts, icons, or reusable design assets in the delivery package.
Changing the assessment-date placeholder does not alter the requirement that the editable templates be straightforward to export as PDFs.
The source change concerns assessment-date text and does not alter the vehicle identifier or its presentation format.
The assessment-date field format does not change the content, brevity, or bullet-point presentation of the front-page result drivers.
The current internal-header requirement is already defined by its coverage, subtle presentation, and example text; the source decision does not necessarily change those attributes.
Replacing raw assessment-date placeholder text does not change the retained visual direction or cross-variant theme.
The assessment-date field format does not modify the score heading, result fields, prominence, spacing, or visibility requirements.
The assessment-date placeholder policy is unrelated to the final-page confidentiality warning and its visual treatment.
The source decision changes assessment-date presentation, not the required DX-17 header identifier.

Although assessment date remains listed as footer content, the source decision does not change footer presence or content membership; the date-format policy is already represented by the dedicated copy requirement.
The assessment-date field format does not alter the DX17–DX20 variant set, editability, or score-and-risk selection basis.
